statusDetail: Anton completed the scheduled site-improvement loop and recorded the result.
actionRequired: No action needed unless you want to review the latest commit.
summary:
Implemented three iPhone-visible slices:

- Added a Quick Sheet `Roadside Command` strip near the top with selected roadside plan, contact/session/cache readiness, and next-tap actions.
- Made Diagnostics symptom picker changes update `?diagnostic=` history, so Back/share restores the selected diagnostic path.
- Added Global Search recent-work recovery for live roadside sessions, preserving the selected roadside stack.

Also bumped the PWA cache to `ridgeline-console-v426` and updated stale smoke assertions for the current Quick Sheet/Search behavior.

Verification:
- Passed focused localhost Playwright checks for Quick Sheet command state/no iPhone overflow, Diagnostics URL/back restore, and Search live-roadside resume.
- Passed `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`.
- Passed `git diff --check`.
- Broader `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1` timed out after stale assertions were repaired; noted in `AGENT_STATE.md`.

Impact Score: 4/5  
Visible Change: Quick Sheet now shows a top roadside command strip, Diagnostics selections become shareable/back-restorable URLs, and Search can reopen a running roadside session.  
Impact Reason: These changes reduce iPhone scrolling and make roadside/diagnostic recovery paths survive reloads, sharing, and back navigation.  
Ended Early Because: Stopped at a clean point after three user-visible slices and focused verification; the remaining broad smoke-wrapper timeout needs a separate audit-health pass.
